sm.$description: Small icon: the check inside a Checkbox.

md.$description: Default icon, and the visual size of Checkbox and RadioGroup controls.

dot.$description: The dot inside a selected radio.

padding.$description: Inner padding of a menu or listbox.

offset.$description: Distance a menu slides in from its trigger, and the vertical margin of a separator.

padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of a menu item and label.

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of a menu item and label.

padding-end.$description: Padding on the end side of an item, leaving room for the selection check.

underline-offset.$description: Gap between link text and its underline.

marker-width.$description: Thickness of the active-tab bar and similar selection markers.
